title: Logistics Yard Cargo Rack Collapse Prevention Record
description: Evidence model for yard and warehouse selective-pallet-rack structural integrity, load-capacity labeling, baseplate anchoring, and stacking-height collapse-prevention inspection. Covers the OSHA-KR Art 100 (붕괴 방지 — yard cargo stacking) hazard that is distinct from refrigerant-gas asphyxiation, crane/AGV lifting mechanics, IMDG dangerous-cargo inhalation, and forklift pedestrian-strike hazards.

max_load_kg_per_beam.description: Rated maximum load capacity (kg) per beam level per the manufacturer's load plate.

load_label_intact.description: True if the manufacturer's load-capacity plate is present and legible on the rack bay.

baseplate_anchored.description: True if all column baseplates are anchored to the slab and shims are in place.
